title: Travel Protection Plans, Medical Section of the Schedule of Benefits
content:
The medical section of the schedule of benefits sets, for each of the Travel Protection Plans, what is
available for illness, injury, dental treatment, evacuation and accidental death. Every figure in this section
is a limit for each insured traveller named on the certificate, and the medical deductible is the amount
withheld from each emergency medical settlement.

| Plan | Emergency medical | Medical deductible | Emergency dental | Evacuation and repatriation | Accidental death and dismemberment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 25000 | 250 | 500 | 100000 | 10000 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 50000 | 150 | 750 | 250000 | 25000 |
| TripGuard Plus | 100000 | 100 | 1000 | 500000 | 50000 |
| TripGuard Premier | 250000 | 0 | 1500 | 1000000 | 100000 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 250000 | 0 | 1500 | 1000000 | 100000 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 150000 | 100 | 1000 | 500000 | 50000 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 500000 | 0 | 2500 | 1000000 | 150000 |

All amounts are in USD, and a medical deductible of 0 means that nothing is withheld from an emergency medical
settlement under that plan.

## The same figures as a comparison

Emergency medical cover rises across the range from 25000 on Trip Basics Essential through 50000 on Trip Basics
Standard, 100000 on TripGuard Plus and 150000 on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, to 250000 on TripGuard Premier and
Cancel For Any Reason Elite and 500000 on Annual Multi-Trip Executive; the medical deductible falls over the same
range from 250 to 150, to 100 on TripGuard Plus and on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, and to nothing on the three
highest plans. Evacuation reaches 1000000 on TripGuard Premier, Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual
Multi-Trip Executive, 500000 on TripGuard Plus and Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, 250000 on Trip Basics Standard
and 100000 on Trip Basics Essential. Dental cover runs from 500 to 2500 and accidental death from 10000 to
150000 across the same seven plans.
